dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, this food court is very big!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðɪs ˈfuːd ˌkɔːrt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈbɪɡ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Take a tray, Emma. Let's buy food.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈteɪk ə ˈtreɪ, ˈɛmə. ˈlɛts ˈbaɪ ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no, there are no seats!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ, ðɛr ər ˈnoʊ ˈsiːts!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː, ɪz ðɪs ˈsiːt ˈteɪkən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Emma, can we share the chicken?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! ˈɛmə, kən wiː ˈʃɛr ðə ˈtʃɪkən?
